body: Continuation of central-chrome-kill-grant-2026-11-16, which is full at 8 KiB (use records 1-7 are there). USE RECORD 8 (Opus2, 2026-11-21). Need: a MEMORY INCIDENT during B646's Windows classification test-ec7cd414 (cold -j1 --bin termal, started 20:59:58Z at 24.7 GiB). FV read 3,764,268 KiB at 21:08:49Z and 1,658,036 at 21:09:22Z, with the launcher reporting STALLED; that is below the owner's 6 GiB self-stop line. Chrome had reopened to 30 processes within 10 minutes of use 7. Authority: the standing grant (Asistant #2113). Fable2 #7285 said a later shortfall is a second need with a second record. I acted without a fresh ask because it was time-critical (the host risked running out of commit). Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome on Central at 21:09:37.21Z, 30 chrome processes. FV before 1,542,088 KiB (21:09:37.04Z); FV after 10,145,480 KiB (21:09:42.64Z), 0 chrome. Nothing else touched; the run's owner was separately told to stop its own run. Reported to Fable2 for Greg. LESSON: Chrome reopens within minutes, not 1-2 h, and can hold more than 8 GiB of commit; a cold Windows build started just after a close is not protected by it.
